shared_elements: a row of repeated figures in profile facing the same direction
raised outlines with flat interior surfaces on the ground plane
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised around a horizontal register containing a row of repeated profile figures moving in one direction, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a narrow upright block with flat, schematic, outline-like animal and abstract motifs stacked in loosely bounded zones, while B is a broad wall panel of modelled, anatomically detailed human figures with garments, headgear and carried objects in a unified procession.
